headline: ARI @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.06 at TBR 4.90, with a projected total of 8.95. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: ARI moved +0.09 runs while TBR moved +0.64, changing the projected margin by -0.55 runs. The projected total climbed +0.73, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Drew Rasmussen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Jonathan Aranda, Gabriel Moreno, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Hunter Feduccia because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
